app.offline.title.description: Bold lead-in of the banner shown while the device has no network

app.offline.body.defaultMessage: Saved pages still open. We'll catch up when you're back online.

app.update.message.defaultMessage: A new version of TodayZ Business is ready.
app.update.message.description: Toast shown when a new version of the app is waiting. The page never reloads until the person taps Update, and never while a sale or checkout is open.

app.update.action.description: Button in the update toast; reloads the app

app.error.title.description: Heading of the screen shown when the app crashes

app.error.body.defaultMessage: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.

app.pending.retry.description: Button under the offline notice when the first sign-in check could not reach the server

app.loading.description: Spoken while the app checks whether you are signed in

auth.signIn.sub.defaultMessage: Use the mobile number your shop is registered with. We'll send a code by SMS.

auth.phone.label.description: Label of the phone field. The +91 prefix is shown beside it.

auth.phone.help.defaultMessage: We use it to sign you in and for order alerts.
auth.phone.help.description: Help text under the phone field

auth.phone.invalid.defaultMessage: Enter a 10-digit mobile number that starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9.

auth.code.send.description: Button that sends the SMS code

auth.code.sending.description: Spoken while the code is being sent

auth.code.label.description: Name of the group of six code boxes

auth.code.digit.description: Name of code box number {position}, 2 to 6

auth.code.sentTo.description: Line above the code boxes. {phone} is the number with some digits hidden.

auth.code.verifying.description: Spoken while the code is being checked

auth.code.resend.description: Button to ask for a new code

auth.code.resendIn.description: Disabled button while the resend timer runs. {seconds} counts down.

auth.code.change.description: Button that goes back to the phone field

auth.error.wrongCode.defaultMessage: That code is not right. Check it and try again.

auth.error.expired.defaultMessage: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.

auth.error.locked.defaultMessage: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new code.
auth.error.locked.description: Too many wrong attempts on one code

auth.error.rateLimited.defaultMessage: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.

auth.error.blocked.defaultMessage: This account can't sign in right now. Contact support.

auth.error.network.defaultMessage: We can't reach TodayZ. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.description: No network or the server did not answer

auth.error.generic.defaultMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.error.captcha.defaultMessage: We couldn't check that you are a person. Reload the page and try again.
auth.error.captcha.description: The Turnstile check failed to load or run

auth.signOut.description: Button that ends the session on this device

shop.pick.sub.defaultMessage: Pick the business and store you want to work in. We'll remember it on this device.
shop.pick.sub.description: B-01 shop picker line under the title

shop.pick.loading.description: Spoken while the list of shops loads

shop.pick.group.description: Accessible name of the store buttons of one business. {business} is the business name.

shop.pick.role.owner.description: Role shown beside a business in the shop picker

shop.pick.role.manager.description: Role shown beside a business in the shop picker

shop.pick.role.cashier.description: Role shown beside a business in the shop picker

shop.pick.empty.defaultMessage: No shop is linked to this number yet. Ask your owner to invite you, or contact support.
shop.pick.empty.description: The signed-in person has no business

shop.pick.unavailable.defaultMessage: We can't load your shops yet. You can carry on to the overview.
shop.pick.unavailable.description: The list of shops could not be loaded

shop.pick.retry.description: Button that loads the list of shops again

shop.pick.continue.description: Button that skips the picker when the list is unavailable

shop.invite.soon.defaultMessage: Accepting an invitation is coming soon. Keep this link; it will work here.
shop.invite.soon.description: Placeholder until invitations can be accepted

shop.invite.home.description: Link out of the invite placeholder
